title: A brief carries the rules of the project's own docs from backlog.json's docs map, and a project that is a kb root gets them as cited fact lines
goal: backlog.json names a docs_map (the kb's is kb/_self/map.csv) and, when the project is a root of a kb (its own or an installed plugin's), the root name; backlog.py brief ID then adds a rules section: for a mapped project the docs its touches map to, by path and heading, and for a kb root the output of rag.py pack --root <root> --item ID (fact lines with path:line and tag), so a worker reads the rules of its files, never the project's whole rulebook (a workspace measured on 2026-10-10 has every worker read a 68 KB rulebook and an 88 KB rulings file before its task). A project with neither prints a one-line note that no docs map is set. /kb-add-root and /kb-ingest are named in kb/_self/backlog.md as the way a project becomes a root.

gates.question: Which backlog.json keys name the docs map and the kb root, and what are the kb's values?
options: docs_map: a repository path to a doc,pattern CSV (kb: kb/_self/map.csv; empty: none); kb_root: the kb root name whose rules rag.py pack --root serves (kb: _self; empty: the project is no root)
one docs object with map and root fields
